newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Floods feared after cyclone in northern Australia.
newsitem.headline: Floods feared after cyclone in northern Australia.

text.p: Australia's emergency services were preparing for flooding in the far north state of Queensland after a tropical cyclone passed through the region on Saturday.
Cyclone Justin hit the far northern town of Cairns earlier on Saturday but caused little damage to buildings or crops.
The Bureau of Meteorology said however that heavy rain was expected over the next few days.

The Australian Maritime Safety Authority said meanwhile it had called off a four-day search for a New Zealand yacht, the Queen Charlotte, after failing to find any sign of the vessel or its five crew.
It said the search would be resumed if any fresh information became available.
